summary: @or-sdk/graph preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's declared preinstall script (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts it, chmods the binary, and invokes it to execute a shipped 727 KB file math_init.js. math_init.js is a Bun-compiled, obfuscator.io-style string-array-with-rotation bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, WV8StW rotation, decoder hc1jfK9, thousands of numeric/string constants, no human-readable strings) whose behavior is unrelated to the advertised graph-SDK functionality. Execution occurs automatically on `npm install` under an alternate runtime that Node-based supply-chain scanners do not inspect. The package is published under the `@or-sdk` scope while its CHANGELOG references `gitlab.internal.onereach.io/onereach/platform/or-sdk-next`, matching the shape of a dependency-confusion lure targeting OneReach.ai internal builds and any CI resolving `@or-sdk/*` from the public npm registry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
